name: El Morado glacier
region: El Morado Natural Monument, Cajón del Maipo
why: The Andes in a day from Santiago: a mountain lagoon under a hanging glacier at 2,500 m.
book: CONAF entry ticket online. Entry closes around midday; the road needs 2 h from Santiago (tours leave early).
water: Streams; nothing to buy after Baños Morales.
dangers: Altitude 1,900-2,500 m: go slowly the first hour.
turnaround: Rangers ask you to start back from the glacier by 15:00.

points.name: Baños Morales
points.note: The ranger post at the end of the village.

points.name: Laguna El Morado
points.note: About 2 h: the lagoon with Cerro El Morado and its glacier behind.

points.name: El Morado glacier foot
points.note: About 2,500 m, under the San Francisco glacier.
